reuse.why: Follows the file's existing NO_TEMPLATE_SQL pattern with a hiddenSql fragment helper used by five of the six actions; copyPreviousMonth keeps its own row-level hidden check, which reads from getBudgetData rather than SQL.

duplication.why: The hidden-category predicate is centralised for the SQL-based actions; the hidden rule still exists in a second form inside copyPreviousMonth, and the six near-identical category queries remain repeated (pre-existing).

placement.why: The helper sits next to the other month-wide exclusion helpers in server/budget/actions.ts.

scope.why: Only the month-wide actions, plus a release note.

maintainability.why: Small and readable; the requireGroup option makes the pre-existing LEFT JOIN/COALESCE inconsistency explicit, though the hidden rule is still decided in two places (SQL helper and copyPreviousMonth's JS condition).

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic is reshaped; the hidden filter is extracted into hiddenSql.
